Faq.title: Everything You Need to Know Before Booking
Faq.subtitle: Transparent answers to the most frequent queries from our Pune customers.
Faq.q1: Do you actually repair the phone in front of me at my home or office?
Faq.a1: Yes! 95% of repairs—including screen replacements, battery swaps, cameras, and charging ports—are performed in front of you on a sterile antistatic mat. You never have to part with your device.
Faq.q2: Do I need to share my lock screen password or format my phone?
Faq.a2: Never. Because the repair happens in front of you, you do not need to share your PIN, password, or wipe your phone. You unlock the phone yourself to test touch and camera functionality once the repair is complete.
Faq.a3: Our warranty covers manufacturing defects, touch responsiveness, display flickering, and battery performance on the replaced parts. If any part fails within the warranty period, we replace it free of charge.
Faq.q4: What if my phone cannot be repaired on the spot?
Faq.a4: If your phone requires complex multi-hour chip-level motherboard micro-soldering, our technician provides a secure receipt and brings it to our centralized Pune lab. We return it within 24-48 hours. If it cannot be fixed, there is zero repair fee.
Faq.q5: Which payment methods are accepted upon completion?
Faq.a5: We accept all major UPI apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit & Debit Cards, and Cash. You only pay after you personally inspect and test the repaired phone.
